offering_description.value: Supplies drinking water and provides sewer service to homes and businesses in Arizona. It operates local water and sewer networks and treats wastewater for reuse in irrigation.

primary_services.value: water distribution; wastewater collection and treatment; reclaimed water delivery

customer_segment.value: B2C: households in utility service areas; B2B: commercial property operators, real estate developers and homeowners associations

end_markets.value: residential communities; commercial real estate; land development; landscape irrigation

revenue_model.value: service fees: monthly water and sewer service charges; transaction or usage fees: metered drinking water and reclaimed water use
revenue_model.category: service fees; transaction or usage fees

value_chain_position.value: asset operator: operates wells, treatment plants and pipe networks that serve local homes and businesses; service provider: collects wastewater from customers and treats it for reuse by irrigation customers

geography_served.value: US regional: Arizona, primarily the Phoenix and Tucson metropolitan areas

specialization.value: related lines: drinking water, sewer service and water reclamation

distribution_channels.value: direct sales: directly billed accounts connected to company-operated water and sewer networks

regulatory_exposure.value: high: Arizona Corporation Commission regulates utility rates and service territories, and Arizona Department of Environmental Quality oversees water quality and wastewater permitting.
